children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may retest a support at $5.30-3/4 per bushel, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $5.21-1/2 to $5.25 range.
The contract has slid below a rising channel. A duplicated channel indicates a target around $5.25. The bearish divergence on the hourly RSI symbolizes a dissipation of the bullish momentum.
The market is more likely to retest $5.30-3/4 than to break $5.39-3/4 and rise toward the $5.42-1/4 to $5.45-1/2 range.
On the daily chart, a projection analysis on a wave C from $4.57-1/4 reveals resistance at $5.39-1/4, which is working with the one at $5.39-1/2 on the hourly chart to stop the rise.
The sideways move over the past few trading sessions is considered a sign of weakness, instead of an accumulation of the bullish momentum.
